execution_rule: Level A closes or precisely reblocks the strongest unresolved evidence gate for each track. Level B reruns admission, accounting, and typed-output gates using Level A results. No Level B result may be inferred from merely starting Level A.

batch_order.purpose: resolve the largest fiscal and endogenous interfaces first
close candidate-specific floor and current-law score gaps
refresh typed release and rate surfaces after upstream results
